title: Codkii ka yimid Geedka Gubanaya
intro: Sharax aqoonsiga shakhsi qoto dheer oo safarkiisu ku bilaabmay kulan mucjiso ah oo qaddarkiisuna uu la xiriiray xoraynta dad la dulmay. Qofkan waxaa loo doortay hawl weyn, isagoo wajahaya caqabado aad u waaweyn oo taageero rabbaani ah haysta.
clues: Waxaan ku dhashay waqti dulmi weyn, halkaas oo lagu dilayay carruurta yaryar ee dadkayga.
Nolosheydii hore waxay ku lug lahayd in waalidkay uu webi dhigo, haddana waxaa la i helay oo la i soo barbaariyay guriga dulmiga dadkayga.
Mar ayaan ka cararay magaalo ka dib markii aan si aan ula kac ahayn u sababay dhimashada qof intii uu socday muran.
Waxaan helay farriin rabbaani ah iyo ul mucjiso ah meel barakeysan, halkaas oo laygu amray inaan la kulmo taliye awood leh.
Walaalkay waxaa loo magacaabay inuu iga caawiyo hawshayda, sababtoo ah caqabad la dareemay oo ku timid hadalkayga.
Waxaan dadkaygii ku hoggaamiyay bad kala qaybsan, anigoo ka baxsanaya raacdada ciidan kaligii talis ah.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
